Steady handheld track follows @Image2 as she walks across the car park toward the promenade. From this mid-stride, she thumbs the cap onto the @Image3, drops the tube into the tote, and keeps walking without breaking pace. She turns her gaze forward, leaving the parked car behind her.

Flip-flops slap the concrete. The tote swings at her hip. Morning sun flashes off chrome and white paint as hair shifts with each step.

early-morning Bondi car park hush, distant surf, light coastal wind. flip-flops slapping concrete, lipstick cap click, tube dropping into canvas tote, tote strap shifting on shoulder.
